name: Scanned Compliance Target
description: A scan run examined a target, and this is how that ended for it. Wildcard target because what a scanner examines is whatever the producer's world has (a package, a host, an image, a repository), and compliance_core must not name a producer's types. The outcome is the producer's own word for it (scanned, not-scanned, failed); without the edge, a target a run could not examine cannot be told from one it examined and found clean.

outcome.description: How the run's examination of this target ended, in the producer's own words (scanned, not-scanned, failed).

reason.description: Why, when the outcome needs saying (the database was stale, the package had no purl).
